thread:
jordan: quick design check? sketch for run history + schema snapshots. goal: let engineers spot output drift and rerun relevant invocations fast.

neha: post the GIF or a quick screenshot?

jordan: added a tiny gif in the thread (frame1 shows compact list, frame2 shows snapshot flyout). top ideas: 1) "snapshot" pill on runs that captures structured-output shape at that time; 2) pin fields from any snapshot so they surface on future runs; 3) inline mini-diff when a pinned field changes.

leo: pin fields is brilliant for customers who only care about e.g. `order.total`. how will pin UI look?

jordan: small pin icon next to each field in the expanded tree. pinned fields appear as a horizontal strip at top of the run when collapsed (value + delta chevron). clicking delta opens a tiny diff popover.

tam: accessibility note: pinned strip needs to be reachable by keyboard and read by screenreaders. use aria-label like "pinned field: order.total, value 12.50". also avoid relying on color alone for up/down delta.

neha: copy tweak: replace "snapshot" with "Recorded schema"? not sure. "Snapshot" might be fine if we add help tooltip.

jordan: leaning toward "Snapshot" (shorter) with a question-mark tooltip: "Captured structured output at timestamp". open to alternatives.

leo: what about pin lifecycle? can pins be global, per-playground, or per-run? I expect ops want global pins for alerts.

jordan: propose three scopes: personal (default), workspace, and baseline (locked by admins). UI to switch scope when pinning. small dropdown.

tam: for streaming outputs: pin should update live if the path appears later in the stream? Or only after run completes?

jordan: tricky. For now, pin binds to the first matching path in the run (if streaming, we show progressively and the pinned value updates live). need aria-live on that element.

neha: UX for diffs: tiny inline summary with emoji arrows and absolute delta e.g. "↑ 2.3". hover shows full JSON diff. copy button next to diff to save for an issue.

leo: keyboard flows: hitting "p" when focused on a field toggles pin. show small toast "Pinned order.total (personal)" with undo.

jordan: nice. toasts should be dismissible and screen-reader friendly.

ux-bot: reminder: run a11y audit when prototype ready.

tam: layout question: should pinned strip be sticky at top of run list when scrolling through runs? helps compare values across many runs.

jordan: yes — make it sticky per page, with an option to collapse. but consider virtualization complexity.

neha: performance: storing snapshots for thousands of runs could be heavy. maybe snapshot only on demand (user clicks record) and auto-snapshot for runs marked as baseline.

jordan: agreed — default: lightweight delta checks computed server-side; full snapshots are created on user request or for baseline runs.

leo: small copy thought: use "Invocation" instead of "Run" in top-level header. customers found "run" ambiguous.

jordan: will change labels across the designs.

tam: one more nit: color contrast on the pinned pill needs to pass WCAG AA. avoid light grey text on white.

jordan: noted. I'll update the palette. I'll push a revised prototype with the pin interactions, keyboard map, and annotated a11y notes before the design sync. thanks!

neha: :+1:

leo: :v:

jordan: ping me if you want to test the prototype interactively.
